name: upload_cloudflare
description: Upload an image to Cloudflare Images CDN. Returns a permanent, PUBLIC CDN URL. WARNING: Uploaded images are publicly accessible to anyone with the URL - do NOT upload screenshots, sensitive documents, personal photos, or anything containing private information. Use for: generated artwork, diagrams, status visuals, shareable content only.

source.description: Image source: file path, URL (https://...), base64 data, or stash reference (stash://space_id/file_id)

source_type.description: Source type. 'auto' (default) detects from source format.

uploader.description: Who is uploading - used for path organization. Default: jarvis

category.description: Category for path organization (status, generated, stash, etc). Auto-detected if not provided.

prompt.description: The prompt used to generate the image (stored as metadata, not public)

tags.description: Tags for the image (stored as metadata, not public)

provider.description: Image provider (gemini, openai, etc) - stored as metadata
